department: Department of Materials Science and NanoEngineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 4, 2026 for priority review and funding; late applications are accepted until December 31, 2026.
deadline.quote: Applications are due the first Friday of December, which for 2026 means December 4, 2026, by 11:59P Central Time. | Late applications will be accepted through December 31, 2026, however, priority review and funding considerations will be given to applications submitted on or before December 4.

fee_waiver.value: The department grants no waivers of its own except for Gulf Coast Undergraduate Research Symposium (GCURS) participants; Rice's central Doctoral Fee Waiver Weeks may still apply.
fee_waiver.quote: we do not grant fee waivers | Our department waives the application fee for participants of Gulf Coast Undergraduate Research Symposium (GCURS).

gre_general.value: The GRE is recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE is recommended but not required.

supervisor.value: The page asks the statement of purpose to name potential advisers but does not require agreement beforehand.

funding.value: The department typically gives full or partial funding to most incoming PhD students in the first year; the adviser then takes over.
funding.quote: The MSNE department typically provides full or partial funding to most incoming PhD students during their first year.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or equivalent is the listed entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree or equivalent undergraduate degree

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not mention a GRE Subject test for this field.
